title: Software Engineer
description:
About Job

We are seeking a results-driven Software Engineer to join a high-performing engineering team focused 

on developing scalable, cloud-native, data-intensive applications. This role is ideal for a highly skilled 

backend engineer with deep experience in database technologies and a strong track record of building 

and supporting data-intensive applications. You will play a critical role in designing scalable, high-performance solutions within our Phoenix system, leveraging a modern tech stack including Python, 

Spark, PostgreSQL, and Airflow.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on mission-critical systems that process massive volumes of 

consumer and retail data for customers around the globe.
Responsibilities
- Design, develop and maintain robust backend systems for high-volume data processing.
- Lead the design and optimization of relational and non-relational databases, with a focus on PostgreSQL.
- Ensure reliability, scalability, and performance of production data pipelines and backend services.
- Provide hands-on production support, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving issues that are time-sensitive for client delivery.
- Collaborate across cross-functional teams involving Product, Operations, Design and Architecture teams to deliver high-impact solutions aligned with business objectives.
- Apply a deep understanding of complex business logic to enhance system capabilities and data workflows.
- Champion best practices in code quality, performance tuning, and maintainability.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across development, deployment, and monitoring processes.
- Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and support.

- 3-7 years of professional software engineering experience developing enterprise-grade applications, with a focus on backend and data systems.
- Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and PySpark for data processing and application development.
- Demonstrated expertise in PostgreSQL, including query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and performance tuning.
- Experience supporting mission-critical, time-sensitive production environments and client facing data delivery.
- Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and scalable system design.
- Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and DevOps practices.
- Proven ability to lead initiatives, mentor peers, and adapt to evolving technical landscapes.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently drive complex technical solutions.
- Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI-enabled development workflows while maintaining engineering rigor, security standards, code quality, and architectural best practices.
- Experience working in Agile development environments.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

title: Platform Software Engineer 2
description:
Delivers routine and some non-routine platform work under moderate supervision, including minor enhancements to shared services, SDKs, or integration adapters. Troubleshoots standard issues across components using established playbooks, helping maintain reliability and backward compatibility. Monitors and analyzes platform API/SDK usage for a subsystem; proposes small improvements to observability and resilience. Updates migration notes and reference implementations within defined guidelines.

Key Responsibilities
Platform Software Development:
- Deliver minor enhancements to shared services, integration adapters, or SDK surfaces within defined guardrails.

- Apply compatibility/versioning rules during fixes and minor rollouts to protect downstream teams.

- Propose small observability/resilience improvements based on API/SDK usage signals for a subsystem.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:
- Contributes to designing software solutions and analyzes requirements to achieve business and operational goals, with limited guidance.

- Adheres to all phases of the software development lifecycle.

- Applies working knowledge to develop and review code for new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code.

- Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix simple and moderately complex software issues.

- Develops fixes for identified issues.

- Implements software testing (e.g., functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, following established frameworks.

- Supports the implementation of standard and non-standard performance profiling and optimization of coding.

- Troubleshoots and resolves standard and non-standard issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.

- Implements standard and non-standard API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:
- Collaborates with own team and begins to network outside of team to understand customer issues and align solutions.

- May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, with limited supervision.

- Assists peers to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.

- Influences efforts to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.

- Utilizes working knowledge to implement customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, with some guidance.

- Collaborates with experienced colleagues to investigate and troubleshoot product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:
- Begins to collaborate with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards.

- Assists in ensuring code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.

- Demonstrates working knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.

- Assists in implementing secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:
- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities), with limited guidance.

- Assists in driving improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
- Tracks timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. Prioritizes and adjusts work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance.

Collaboration & Partnership:
- Collaborates within a team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance. Actively listens and asks questions to enhance collaboration.

Problem Solving:
- Identifies and addresses issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures. Compiles and reviews data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors.

Continuous Learning:
- Seeks opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. Utilizes feedback and training to improve skills. Participates in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.

Continuous Improvement:
- Implements updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed with some guidance. Contributes to ideation for future process improvements.

Delivers routine and some non-routine platform work under moderate supervision, including minor enhancements to shared services, SDKs, or integration adapters.

title: Software Engineer
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

What you get to do in this role:   
- Build AI-native features that use generative and agentic AI capabilities to improve Finance and Procurement workflows and insights, and deliver real value to customers.
- Apply AI tools effectively across the development lifecycle, including code generation, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review, while validating output for correctness, security, and maintainability.
- Write clean, scalable, reusable code and uphold engineering best practices: code reviews, unit testing, and automated test coverage that keeps releases stable and production-ready.
- Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements, and own your work end to end from design and implementation through test automation and delivery.
- Design software and APIs that customers can easily extend and customize to meet their specific needs.
- Build accessible, performant, componentized user interfaces that work consistently across web, workspace and mobile experiences.
- Investigate and resolve customer-reported defects and escalations, finding root causes across client, server and platform layers.
- Help design and implement new products and features while enhancing the existing product suite.

To be successful in this role you have:
- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
- 2+ years of experience with Java or a similar object-oriented language, and strong JavaScript skills.
- A passion for the Web as a platform, reusability and componentization, with experience in a modern UI framework such as Angular, React or Lit.
- Experience with data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance and scale considerations.
- Experience building or consuming REST APIs. Exposure to generative AI or LLM-based features (prompting, grounding, evaluating output quality) is a plus.
- Experience with test automation and a strong quality mindset, plus a working understanding of web accessibility.
- Strong analytical, debugging and design skills.
- Working knowledge of everyday tools: IDE, debugger, build tools, source control, profilers.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer L4
description:
Who We Are

Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.

Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.

Who You Are

You are a Senior Software Development Engineer L4 with strong full stack engineering experience and a passion for building scalable, high-quality applications. You will work across backend services, user interfaces, databases, and cloud environments to deliver reliable software in an Agile team setting. In this role, you help drive technical execution by partnering with cross-functional teammates to solve complex problems and improve application performance. Your work contributes directly to delivering dependable solutions for the business and the clients we serve.

What You'll Do

• Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full stack applications that meet quality, performance, and reliability expectations.  

• Build and enhance backend services using Java, Core Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.  

• Develop responsive, maintainable user interfaces using Angular to support strong user experience and application usability.  

• Write optimized SQL queries and manage interactions with relational databases to support application functionality and performance.  

• Deploy, support, and maintain applications in cloud environments, with a preference for AWS-based implementations.  

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to plan, deliver, and improve high-quality software solutions.  

• Participate in code reviews and apply engineering best practices, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and maintainable coding standards.  

• Troubleshoot production issues, debug complex application problems, and drive continuous improvements in system stability and performance.  

What You'll Need

• 5 to 8 years of hands-on full stack development experience.  

• [CONFIRM: required education] or equivalent combination of education and experience required.  

• Strong experience in Java, including Core Java, Spring Boot, and microservices.  

• Hands-on experience with Angular for frontend development.  

• Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases.  

• Experience working with cloud platforms, with AWS preferred.  

• Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, and distributed systems.  

• Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development methodologies.  

• Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.  

• Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment while building high-quality solutions.  

• Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by quickly learning new technologies, expanding technical scope, and applying new knowledge to improve delivery and software quality.  

• Show leadership through effective collaboration, constructive participation in technical discussions, and positive influence across engineering and cross-functional partners, including during code reviews and problem resolution.  

• Adapt to changing priorities, evolving requirements, and ambiguity while staying focused on delivery, quality, and outcomes in a fast-moving Agile environment.  

• Apply creative thinking to solve engineering challenges, improve systems, and identify practical ways to build more scalable and effective applications.  

• Use analytical skills to evaluate technical issues, interpret system behavior, identify root causes, and make sound decisions based on evidence and data.  

• Nice to have: Experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and ECS. Exposure to AI-driven development tools and practices, including GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar tools. Understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.  

Our Shared Commitments

• Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;  

• Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and  

• Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.  

Work Environment

• This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

title: Senior Data Systems Software Engineer
location: India; BENGALURU, KARNATAKA, India; NOIDA, UTTAR PRADESH, India
description:
Senior Data System Software engineer: Oracle Database 26ai and client drivers System Test Engineering

Database Product Development | Senior Lead or Principal Level

Role summary This role combines hands-on Oracle database development with component, integration, system, stress, and performance testing. The engineer will build automated test solutions for Oracle Database 26ai, Oracle client drivers, converged database features, and the major Oracle client drivers on Windows and Linux.
Team and mission
The SHARP VLDB organisation improves the scalability, high availability, reliability, and performance of Oracle Database and cloud services. The team designs realistic, high-volume and highly concurrent workloads that expose product defects and architectural limitations before release. Engineers work closely with database kernel, feature, client drivers, cloud, and support teams to reproduce issues, verify fixes, and strengthen product quality across on-premises and cloud deployments.
Role at a glance

 Primary focus

 Database feature development and cross-platform system test engineering

 Target database

 Oracle Database 26ai with vector and AI capabilities

 Platforms

 Windows Server and Linux, including cross-platform compatibility and interoperability

 Database areas

 XDB, JSON, Oracle Text, SQL and PL/SQL, multitenant and high availability

 ODAC scope

 ODP.NET Core, Managed and Unmanaged providers and related ODAC components

 Client drivers

 python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI-C driver and JDBC

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Who We Are 
 
At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support. 
Bluehost is in growth mode, and this role is part of the team building the next generation of AI-powered customer experiences. You'll work across the stack of Python, AI agents, React, Java/Spring Boot, LLMs, APIs and data layers. You'll have the opportunity to design and ship production systems while developing strong skills in system design, scalability, reliability, and AI engineering. 
 
What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

- Participate actively in code review and pull-request discussions, both giving and receiving feedback that sharpens the whole team's craft 
- Debug and resolve production issues across frontend, Java services, Python, APIs, databases, and AI components using logs, tracing, browser tooling, and monitoring dashboards. 
- Ship features that reach small-business customers directly, in an Agile/Scrum cadence with real sprint ownership 
- Contribute to a fast-moving, modernizing codebase while identifying opportunities to improve architecture, scalability, reliability, AI quality, and developer experience. 
- Participate in technical design and architecture decisions, considering scalability, reliability, latency, cost, security, data flow, caching, asynchronous processing, and failure handling. 
 
Who You Are & What You'll Need to Succeed 
- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally building customer-facing production systems. 
- Strong proficiency in Python, including building production services with FastAPI or similar frameworks.
- Hands-on experience building AI agents, including tool/function calling and multi-agent orchestration with frameworks such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, or CrewAI.
- Shipping Generative AI features to production, not just prototypes, with depth in at least one of RAG and vector search, prompt engineering, or LLM evaluation and observability.

- Strong understanding of system design fundamentals, including API design, databases, caching, asynchronous processing, messaging/queues, scalability, reliability, observability, and distributed-system tradeoffs.

You review AI-generated code knowing its failure modes, and you work within clear boundaries for what customer data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for.

Why You'll Love Us

Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.

title: Software Engineer II - Vault CRM - Administrator and UIX Designer with X-Pages
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Position Summary
We are seeking a hands-on Veeva technical engineer to join our Global Sales Systems and Capabilities team within CBIT (Commercial Business Insights & Technology) in Hyderabad. As BMS moves from Veeva CRM on Salesforce to Veeva Vault CRM, you will work mainly on Vault CRM, building field-facing X-Pages and configuring and extending Vault CRM capabilities to support BMS field processes.
This is a senior, build-focused role, not a pure administration or generic Salesforce development role. We are looking for someone with a strong Veeva CRM and MyInsights background who can carry that experience onto Vault CRM and X-Pages, and who can judge what should be migrated, redesigned, replaced or retired. If you are looking for a meaningful and rewarding career, we encourage you to apply and become part of our diverse team!

Key ResponsibilitiesX-Pages Development (Primary Focus)
- Design, develop, enhance, troubleshoot and maintain X-Pages that give field users rich, intuitive experiences on iPad, browser and other Vault CRM surfaces, using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript and component-based frameworks where appropriate.
- Integrate X-Pages with Vault CRM data, objects, processes and workflows through the X-Pages JavaScript library and platform APIs, placing them in the right business context (account, call, territory, home page) while respecting user security and data visibility.
- Build for performance and offline use, with efficient queries, minimal payloads, caching and graceful handling of connectivity changes on mobile devices.
- Establish reusable X-Pages patterns, component libraries, coding standards and packaging/deployment practices that keep solutions consistent, secure and maintainable.
Vault CRM Platform Capabilities (Primary Focus)
- Configure and extend Vault CRM, including objects, object types, fields, page layouts and settings, and use the Vault Java SDK where platform extensions are appropriate.
- Design and maintain the security model, including security profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, territory-based and dynamic access control, and user administration.
- Configure business processes using lifecycles, states, workflows and related automation, and support core field capabilities such as account management, call reporting, territory and alignment, sampling, Approved Email, CLM, Engage, surveys and events.
- Support content, reporting and broader Veeva ecosystem connections, such as Vault PromoMats and MedComms, OpenData and Network, and Vault CRM reports and dashboards.
- Manage configuration across sandbox and production vaults using migration packages and MDL, assess the impact of Veeva releases, and account for mobile sync and offline behavior.
- Design, build and support integrations with upstream and downstream systems using the Vault REST API, VQL, Vault Loader and BMS middleware, working with integration and data teams to keep field data accurate and timely.
Migration and Transformation
- Support and, where appropriate, lead technical workstreams for the transition from Veeva CRM on Salesforce to Vault CRM.
- Use your Veeva CRM and MyInsights experience to assess existing customizations, MyInsights solutions, integrations, data and configuration, and recommend whether each should be migrated, redesigned, replaced with standard Vault CRM functionality, or retired.
- Redesign MyInsights solutions as X-Pages where needed, taking advantage of Vault CRM capabilities rather than reproducing legacy limitations.
- Support data migration validation, integration cut-over, testing and hypercare, and provide limited support for the existing Veeva CRM and MyInsights solutions while they remain in use.
Delivery and Collaboration
- Champion an AI-first engineering mindset — embedding AI coding assistants, LLM-augmented development workflows, and automated testing into day-to-day engineering practice to accelerate delivery and raise code quality.  
- Work with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, integration teams, vendors and other Veeva platform teams, including onshore and global peers, to turn business needs into sound technical solutions and explain options and trade-offs clearly.
- Lead and coach a small offshore team of developers (3-5) through technical guidance, code reviews and onboarding of new talent.
- Deliver through Agile, CI/CD and source control practices, partner with testing teams to resolve defects and performance issues, and follow SDLC, configuration management and enterprise architecture standards.
- Maintain required documentation (SDD, configuration trackers, deployment checklists, change requests, test evidence, ITQM, SIS/SIP, knowledge-base articles and SOPs), and raise risks and improvement opportunities early.
Qualifications & ExperienceRequired:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- 6+ years of IT experience in software development, configuration and support, including at least 4 years of hands-on Veeva CRM technical work, with strong knowledge of its configuration, data model and field processes.
- Proven hands-on MyInsights development experience, which forms the foundation for the X-Pages work in this role.
- Hands-on experience with X-Pages and Vault CRM, or recent Vault CRM project experience with the ability to become productive in X-Pages quickly.
- Solid understanding of Vault CRM architecture and capabilities, including the data model, security, lifecycles and workflows, configuration management, APIs and mobile/offline behavior.
- Strong front-end skills in HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript (ES6+), including debugging, responsive design and mobile performance tuning.
- Experience with REST API integrations, SDLC methodologies (Agile and Waterfall), and validated systems in the life sciences domain.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills.
Ideal Candidates Would Also Have:
- Direct experience on a Veeva CRM to Vault CRM migration, including converting MyInsights solutions to X-Pages.
- Experience with React or Vue, TypeScript, and charting libraries such as Chart.js, D3 or Highcharts.
- Experience with the Vault Java SDK, VQL, MDL and Vault configuration migration packages.
- Experience with Veeva Events Management, and a basic understanding of Veeva Align (vAlign) setup.
- Experience with the broader Veeva ecosystem, such as Vault PromoMats, MedComms, OpenData, Network or Link.
- Veeva Vault CRM, Vault Platform or Veeva CRM certifications.
- Experience with CI/CD tools, Git and Agile tools such as Jira.
- Prior life sciences or healthcare industry experience, and a track record of building strong relationships across a matrix team.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Company Overview

DROS makes debt collections efficient using AI. Our platform autonomously makes phone calls, identifies the right customer, holds natural conversations, collects payments, sends follow-up SMS messages, and records every interaction—all while operating within strict regulatory requirements.

We build systems that operate in a latency-sensitive, compliance-driven environment where reliability, correctness, and observability are fundamental. Every webhook, API call, and policy decision directly impacts a live customer interaction.

Position Summary

We're in the middle of one of the most exciting phases of our platform's evolution.

As we onboard more customers and expand our platform, we're investing heavily in scaling our backend for reliability, performance, and operational excellence. You'll help build the systems and engineering foundations that enable us to grow with confidence.

You'll join while the platform architecture is still taking shape. The systems and patterns you build today will become the foundation the engineering team builds upon for years to come.

This is an opportunity to own core platform components—not maintain someone else's legacy system.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build backend services in TypeScript running on Cloud Run and GKE.

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Summary:

Your work will touch critical paths that process billions of messages per month, demanding reliability, throughput, and correctness at scale.

Team & System Overview:

The Conversations organization powers multi-channel communication across SMS, Email, WhatsApp, and DMs — handling over 2B messages each month. The Threads & Composer team owns the inbox and composer surfaces, and the backend services that deliver and store those interactions.You’ll work across Node.js microservices, GCP-based infra (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks), and MongoDB/Firestore storage layers, ensuring every message and UI state stays consistent, fast, and recoverable.

- Backend ownership: Design and maintain Node.js/NestJS services for message storage, retrieval, and state sync
- API design: Build well-typed REST contracts for Threads and Composer operations
- Data layer work: Model and optimize MongoDB/Firestore schemas for high read/write volumes and atomic updates
- Scalability & resilience: Implement queues, caching, and rate limiting to handle burst traffic gracefully
- Frontend integration: Ship modular Vue 3 UIs that consume your APIs efficiently and handle realtime state updates
- Observability: Instrument logs, metrics, and traces to monitor latency, error rates, and throughput
- Testing discipline: Maintain high coverage across unit, integration, and contract tests
- Production ownership: Participate in on-call, debug incidents, and drive post-mortem action items to closure
- Collaboration & mentorship: Work closely with Product and Frontend leads while reviewing code and supporting junior engineers

Requirements:

- 4+ years of professional engineering experience, preferably backend-heavy full-stack work
- Expert in Node.js and TypeScript; comfortable with NestJS or Express microservices
- Proficient in Vue 3 or similar modern frontend frameworks
- Strong understanding of API design, data modeling, and distributed system patterns
- Experience with GCP (or AWS), containerization, and CI/CD automation
- Hands-on with observability and production monitoring
- Bonus: Pub/Sub or message queue experience; event-driven or domain-driven design background

Technical Environment:

- Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS / Express, REST APIs
- Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Vite / Webpack, Tailwind
- Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, Redis
- Infra: GCP (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Stackdriver)
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes
- Testing: Jest, Vitest

title: Software Engineering Lead
description:
About Airbound

Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.

This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.

The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.

To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

About Flight Systems

The hardware on the drone is only half of what keeps it up in the air. The rest is the software both on the craft and on our ground station. Our unique dual motor thrust vectored tailsitter with blended wing body design has to fly in almost all weather-including heavy winds and light rains autonomously. We're targeting 1000s of flights per day across all locations, requiring us to rethink everything from firmware, controls, state estimation to even ground control and fleet management software. We've achieved an industry-leading payload-to-weight ratio of ~2kg drone for 1kg payload and we're pushing this even further. Every gram matters when you're revolutionizing logistics. This is where cutting-edge aerospace engineering meets software scalability meets real-world impact. title: Sr. SDE (Email)
description:
About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Team:

The Email team owns the Email platform behind HighLevel's email experience, which powers 40M+ emails a day. We own the full path from compose to inbox, so the reliability, speed and quality of what we ship directly decide whether emails from over a million businesses land in the inbox.

We are responsible for:

- Email Platform: The Vue.js apps used to design, compose and send emails, plus the Node.js/NestJS services behind them.
- Sending Infrastructure & Deliverability: IP pools, dedicated IPs, dedicated domains and shared domain pools. These let new users send from day one, while we stay accountable for getting their email into the inbox.
- API-First Platform: Every capability is exposed through APIs, so email can be built into any product or workflow that needs it.
- Scale & Reliability: Keeping throughput high at peak load, with high uptime and send success rates.
- Email Statistics & Analytics: Integrating email stats with internal teams and making every release measurable on our dashboards.
- AI in Email: Bringing LLM-powered capabilities into email creation, while weighing token cost, latency and quality 

Impact & Scale

Email is one of the most critical channels on HighLevel. When it works, businesses grow; when it breaks, their customers stop hearing from them. That's the weight this role carries.

- Businesses: Every one of the 1M+ businesses on HighLevel relies on email to reach their customers.
- Sub-accounts: Your work runs across 1.6M+ sub-accounts, from solo operators to agencies managing hundreds of clients.
- End users: What you ship reaches end users through 1.2B+ emails every month.
- Volume: 40M+ emails a day flow through the systems you'll own, so a 1% gain in reliability or deliverability affects hundreds of thousands of emails daily.
- Blast radius: One change can affect every business on the platform at once, which is why we care so much about reliability, data integrity and security.

How We Work

- Iterate fast: Go from idea to prototype to production in days, not quarters. Ship small, measure, learn and improve.
- Use AI well: Use AI across the whole cycle (design, coding, testing, reviews and debugging) to move faster without lowering the quality bar, and pick the right model for each job based on quality, latency and cost.

About the Role:

The traditional model of siloed product managers, designers and engineers is too slow for AI-native development. At HighLevel, every engineer owns a product outcome end to end, from idea to prototype to production to scale. You will operate as a Team of One. Scale, Performance & Reliability

Engineering Quality & Security

Operational Excellence

- Build evaluation loops for continuous quality improvement.

Requirements

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Join Revun as a Full-Stack Developer to scale web applications using cutting-edge technology. Build robust API integrations and enhance coding with AI tools, working in a fast-paced environment.

About Revun

Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. Where other tools solve one piece of the puzzle, Revun unifies leasing, payments, maintenance, communications, compliance, reporting, and brokerage workflows into a single operating system. Owners, property managers, brokerages, leasing teams, maintenance companies, and REITs all operate from the same connected platform, with role-based experiences that adapt to each stakeholder. Based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

About The Role

As a Full-Stack Developer at Revun, you'll be at the forefront of scaling our web applications. Your day-to-day tasks include reviewing sprint tasks, refactoring backend logic in Laravel, and designing responsive frontends using Tailwind CSS. You will engage with third-party API integration and leverage AI coding assistants to enhance your workflows.

Working closely with the Lead Developer and reporting to the Technical Lead/Founder, your responsibilities include delivering clean, modular code, ensuring zero-downtime deployments, and accelerating development velocity through AI tools. Your success will be assessed by your ability to meet sprint deadlines and ship functional code features consistently.

Within the first 90 days, you'll focus on successfully integrating APIs and leveraging AI tools to accelerate development while maintaining strong code standards. A successful candidate is resourceful, embraces modern coding tools, and communicates progress effectively.

What you will do

- Deliver clean, modular, and scalable code using Laravel and Tailwind CSS or any other modern frontend framework to enhance web application performance and client project outcomes.
- Review sprint tasks, manage pull requests, and refactor backend logic in collaboration with the team, ensuring consistency and quality.
- Write and refactor both backend logic in Laravel and design responsive frontend layouts using Tailwind CSS and Blade components.
- Test and debug third-party API connections, handle complex payloads, and manage error logs effectively.
- Leverage AI coding assistants to draft boilerplate structures, write unit tests, and iterate on feature implementation rapidly.
- Complete assigned feature sprints, conduct code reviews, and test API endpoints to ensure stability and performance.
- Optimize database queries, perform security audits of input validations, and update documentation for integrated modules to maintain system integrity.
- Successfully integrate APIs and leverage AI tools within the first 90 days to accelerate development velocity while maintaining rigorous code standards.
- Troubleshoot unforeseen API documentation errors and resolve merge conflicts or unexpected breaking changes efficiently.

What we are looking for

- At least 4 years of hands-on experience in web development with SaaS or client applications.
- In-depth experience with PHP and the Laravel framework for building robust applications.
- Strong proficiency in full-stack Laravel development, including backend services and frontend frameworks such as Vue.js or any similar JavaScript framework.
- Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs, payment gateways, and CRM systems like Zoho.
- Solid understanding of MySQL, database schema design, and Git version control workflows.
- Fluent in English, with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
- Clear communication skills in providing progress updates and resolving development issues.

Nice to have

- Experience in software development within the IT sector.
- Proficiency in AI-assisted development tools like Cursor, Claude, and OpenAI APIs to enhance coding speed and quality.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

What we offer

CAD $18,000 to $30,000 per year.

Benefits

- Remote work flexibility
- Professional development opportunities

Schedule

Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (EST Timezone).

What happens next

Our recruitment partner will be in touch with you about your application.

If you meet the requirements for the role, they will send you a link to an online video interview that you complete in your own time — there is no appointment to book and nothing to install.

Your completed interview is then shared with us to review alongside your application, and we will let you know what happens next.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
For nearly 40 years, PDI has helped convenience retailers and petroleum wholesalers adapt to changes in the industry by leveraging the latest technologies. Simplifying the complexity in your world is our main focus. That's why we're delivering an integrated portfolio of global, cloud-based solutions and services to meet our customers needs today and well into the future. From the back office to fuel logistics, and the latest wave of consumer demands and digital commerce, PDI solutions and services are designed to give you a competitive edge. Our deep domain knowledge is backed by our industry-specific software offerings and a people-first approach. Serving the entire supply chain means that we’ve had to solve a wide range of industry challenges and deliver measurable value. To address the increasingly dynamic convenience retail and petroleum wholesale industry, PDI leads the way with converged digital, cloud-optimized, secure, and scalable solutions including ERP, Loyalty, Fuel Pricing, Point-of-Sale and Logistics to create a broader industry ecosystem. The result is unparalleled insights, simplified operations, and higher profitability for your employees and business. We’re dedicated to helping our more than 1,500 customers in over 50 countries, providing solutions and services to over 200,000 sites.

PDI C-Store Essentials is cloud back-office software for convenience store owners and operators. It covers pricebook and promotions, point-of-sale integration, fuel, lottery, daily paperwork, scan data reporting and subscription billing, for single stores, chains and franchise operators.

You will build and maintain features across the Essentials web application, its .NET services and its databases, as part of a team split between India and the United States. The team works AI-first: coding agents are part of how every engineer plans, builds, tests and reviews work, and this role is expected to use them well from day one. 

Job Responsibilities: 
- Design, build and ship features across the stack: React and TypeScript on the front end, ASP.NET Core services and APIs on the back end, SQL Server and PostgreSQL underneath

- Take part in design decisions for new and existing features, raise risks early and ask for help when blocked

- Work with the Product Owner to clarify requirements, break them into small deliverable pieces and estimate them

- Write automated tests for your own work (xUnit, Vitest, Playwright) and work with QA engineers on test plans and release stabilization. 

- Troubleshoot and fix development and production issues with urgency, using logs and monitoring to find the root cause. 

- Review teammates' pull requests and respond to review on your own. 

- Keep documentation of what you build current, including the instructions and context that coding agents rely on

- Give your manager clear status and risk updates so work stays on schedule. 

AI-driven development (AIDLC) The team follows an AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC): coding agents take part in every stage of delivery, and engineers direct, check and own the result. This is a core requirement of the role, not a preference.
 
You will be expected to:

- Use coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor every day, across requirements, design, implementation, testing, code review and debugging. 

- Turn a user story into a clear, bounded task an agent can carry out: the goal, the constraints, the files and data involved, and how success will be checked. 

- Plan before generating: have the agent propose an approach, challenge it, and agree the design before code is written. 

- Verify everything an agent produces. Read the diff, run the tests, exercise the change in the running application, and reject work you cannot explain. 

- Own what you merge. Code written by an agent is held to the same standard as code written by hand, and you answer for it in review and in production. 

- Keep credentials, customer data and other sensitive information out of prompts and agent context, and follow PDI's AI usage policies. 

- Improve the team's shared setup: project instructions, reusable prompts and skills, test fixtures and other context that make agents more reliable for everyone. 

- Know when not to use an agent and recognize when one is going in circles or producing plausible but wrong output. 

Required Skills & Experience:
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field plus 4 to 6 years of experience building or maintaining software in a product development environment, or equivalent experience

- Working proficiency in C# and .NET (ASP.NET Core), including building and consuming REST APIs. 

- Working proficiency in a modern JavaScript framework with TypeScript; React is preferred. 

- Solid SQL skills on a relational database (SQL Server or PostgreSQL): queries, stored procedures and basic performance tuning. 

- Hands-on experience using coding agents or AI coding assistants in real project work, and the ability to show how you directed and verified their output. 

- Computer science fundamentals: object-oriented programming, design patterns, data structures and algorithms. 

- Practical experience with Git, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines and Agile delivery. 

- Habit of writing automated tests for your own code. 

- Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical concepts in non-technical terms. Clear writing matters more here than usual, because it is also how you direct agents. 

- Self-starter who can work independently as part of a distributed team, manage competing priorities and learn an unfamiliar codebase quickly. 

Other Skills and Experience: 
- AWS experience: Lambda, SQS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch

- Experience building agent workflows: custom instructions, skills, MCP servers or agent-run test and review loops. 

- React Native or Expo mobile development. 

- Payments or subscription billing integrations, such as Stripe. 

- Retail, convenience store, point-of-sale or fuel domain experience. 

- Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Docker and infrastructure as code (OpenTofu or Terraform). 

- Monitoring and tracing with Datadog or a similar tool

- Experience maintaining or migrating a legacy .NET Framework application. 

Behavioral Competencies:

- Cultivates Innovation

- Decision Quality

- Manages Complexity

- Drives Results

- Business Insight 

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
TITLE

Senior Full-Stack Developer

Who We Are

Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.

Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.

About Vista

Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.

Position Overview

We build and run a multi-tenant risk-management platform for commercial insurance. Underwriters and loss-control consultants use it to survey sites, raise recommendations, and track whether anyone actually did anything about them. It is a real product with real customers and about fifteen years of history. The work is roughly half building new things and half making old things behave.

This engineer will own features end to end. Angular in the browser, .NET on the server, SQL Server and MongoDB underneath, deployed through our own pipeline to customer sandboxes. This is not full stack used as a polite word for front-end work with occasional API calls. They will write the query, the endpoint, the component and the test.

As a Senior Analyst in Full Stack Engineering, you’ll own features end to end across the browser, server, data layers, and tests. You’ll design, develop, enhance, test, troubleshoot, and support software solutions; contribute to technical design decisions; and collaborate with engineering and business partners.

You’ll work with Angular 16, TypeScript, RxJS, Kendo UI for Angular, Angular Material, Bootstrap, and SignalR. The back end includes C# and .NET services, SQL Server, MongoDB, Kafka, xUnit, and Moq. The platform includes a classic ASP.NET Website alongside the modern Angular application. Our delivery environment includes Kubernetes through Rancher Desktop, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and yuniql database migrations.

What You’ll Do

- Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain full stack software components across front-end, back-end, integration, and data layers in alignment with Duck Creek engineering standards.
- Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements to determine appropriate software design approaches, implementation options, and solution impacts.
- Build and maintain scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable application features using established software development methodologies, coding standards, and architecture patterns.
- Contribute to technical design activities, including application flow, component interaction, API design, data structures, integration points, and system behavior.
- Develop and support front-end application functionality, including user interface components, client-side logic, usability considerations, and integration with services or APIs.
- Develop and support back-end application functionality, including business logic, service layers, APIs, data access, system integrations, and application performance considerations.
- Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software defects, production issues, configuration problems, and technical anomalies using structured analytical and problem-solving techniques.
- Perform code reviews, unit testing, integration testing support, debugging, and technical validation to ensure solution quality, maintainability, and adherence to standards.
- Collaborate with architects, product owners, business analysts, quality engineers, DevOps engineers, and other technical stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess risks, and deliver effective solutions.
- Adapt existing approaches, frameworks, and technical patterns to address non-routine problems where information may be limited, incomplete, or subject to interpretation.
- Support continuous improvement of engineering practices, including automation, reusable components, development processes, documentation, code quality, and technical knowledge sharing.
- Advise peers and cross-functional partners on technical matters within the full stack engineering discipline, including solution behavior, implementation considerations, and issue resolution approaches.
- Front end Angular 16 with Kendo UI for Angular, Angular Material and Bootstrap. State is a hand-rolled Behavior Subject store rather than NgRx, which was a deliberate choice and is occasionally annoying. Lazy-loaded feature modules behind a module registry. SignalR for live updates. Four locales.
- There are two front ends. The modern Angular application, and a classic ASP.NET Website that predates it, which has no project file and is still load-bearing. They are bridged by Angular components compiled to custom elements and embedded into the older pages. It is a managed mess, and whoever joins will spend time there.

Back end

A .NET 10 service in clean architecture, tested with xUnit and Moq. MongoDB holds configuration documents and SQL Server carries the query workload. Multi-tenancy is enforced on every request from a JWT claim, so one customer seeing another customer's data is the failure mode we design against. There is also a .NET Core 3.1 service not yet retired, Kafka between several workers, and a newer .NET 10 microservice handling large file uploads.

Infrastructure

Kubernetes locally through Rancher Desktop. Jenkins for CI/CD. Azure DevOps for work items and source. Static analysis, dependency scanning, secret detection and DAST in the pipeline. Database migrations through yuniql across per-tenant databases.

What Success Looks Like

Days one to three. Local environment running and a small fix shipped end to end to a sandbox. Our setup is documented in enough detail that an agent can work through most of it.

Through the first release. Defects, and only defects. This is deliberate. Working through real bugs across the whole system is how someone learns where the two front ends meet, where multi-tenancy is enforced, and how our review process behaves under pressure.

Month two or three. Ownership of something substantial. A slice of the Angular and Kendo upgrade, or a feature in the dashboard service. By this point they should be the person others ask about some part of the system.

title: Software Development Engineer II - CRM
description:
About HighLevel:

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

What are we hiring for?

The systems that run millions of businesses.

Every month, 2.6 billion messages flow through our platform. Our automation engine enrolls 3.1 billion contacts and executes 21.5 billion workflow actions in the same window - with API traffic peaking at 28,000+ requests per second. If these systems lag, businesses lose leads. If they go down, people lose income.

You haven't built at this scale yet. That's fine - almost nobody has.

What we're hiring for is the engineer who reads those numbers and feels pulled toward them. Who wants to know what a queue looks like when it's absorbing a 10x burst, what an index does at 1.5 TB, what "eventually consistent" actually means when a customer is staring at the screen. You'll work on real production paths from week one — with senior engineers around you who've broken and fixed these systems before. You'll build. You'll break things. You'll learn faster here than anywhere else.

Responsibilities:

- Build and ship features in Node.js / Go services that sit on real production paths — your code handles live traffic, not toy problems 
- Own well-scoped services and components end to end: code, tests, rollout, and monitoring 
- Work with SQL and NoSQL data stores — writing queries, adding indexes, and learning why the schema looks the way it does 
- Get hands-on with queues, caches, and rate limiters — the building blocks of every system here 
- Ship Vue 3 UIs that consume your own APIs — clean components, sane state management, and realtime updates that don't flicker or drift 
- Write design docs for your features and defend them in review — clear thinking, honest trade-offs 
- Join the on-call rotation with backup from senior engineers — incidents are where the deepest learning happens 
- Ask questions relentlessly, absorb feedback from code reviews, and level up fast 

Requirements:

- 2+ years of backend engineering experience with strong fundamentals in Node.js, Go, or a comparable language — and the drive to go deep in ours 
- Working knowledge of queues or async processing — you've used Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar, and want to master delivery semantics, ordering, and backpressure 
- Genuine interest in distributed systems — you understand the basics (idempotency, retries, consistency trade-offs) and are hungry to learn the rest by building 
- Hands-on with Redis or another cache/in-memory store, even at small scale 
- Comfortable with SQL or NoSQL databases — you can model data, write efficient queries, and reason about indexes 
- Proficient in Vue 3 or a similar modern frontend framework — solid component design and real experience with state management (Pinia, Vuex, or equivalent) 
- You write tests as a habit and can put your design thinking into a clear doc 
- AI-native builder — you code with agents daily and are pushing to get accurate, production-quality output from them 

Technical Environment:

- Languages: Node.js (TypeScript), Go 
- Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Vite, Tailwind 
- Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, Redis, ElasticSearch, ClickHouse 
- Infra: GCP — GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks 
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes 

Why This Role

Most engineers spend years at companies where "scale" means a few hundred requests per second — and never find out what they're capable of.

Here, the systems are the teacher. Every design decision has a visible consequence at billions of events a month. Every incident is a masterclass. You'll sit in architecture reviews with staff engineers debating storage engines and consistency models — and within a year, you'll be contributing to those debates, not just watching them.

If you optimize your career for learning velocity, there is no faster track than this.

On AI

We're past the debate. AI is part of how we build - and we expect you to be hungry for it.

You already code with agents daily. You're learning what they're good at, where they hallucinate, and how to get accurate, tested, slop-free code out of them fast. You treat AI as a multiplier on your learning speed, not a substitute for understanding.

If you're still copy-pasting from a chat window and hoping, this isn't the seat for you.

What You're Built For

- You're deeply curious — you don't stop at "it works," you need to know why it works 
- You read post-mortems and system-design write-ups for fun, not because someone assigned them 
- You've built things beyond your job description — side projects, internal tools, that one system you rewrote because the old one bothered you 
- You take feedback like a gift: code review comments make your next PR better, every time 
- When something breaks, your first instinct is curiosity, not panic 

What Success Looks Like

- You own a service or component that the team trusts you on completely 
- You're a dependable on-call engineer — you've debugged real incidents and shipped the fixes 
- Your design docs have gone from "reviewed heavily" to "approved with nits" 
- Senior engineers pull you into harder problems — because you've earned it 
- You're visibly on the path to SDE-3, and everyone around you knows it 

Bonus Points

- Familiarity with our stack: GCP, MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch 
- You've contributed to a messaging, automation, or event-driven system — at any scale 
- Side projects or open-source work that shows you build because you can't not build

title: Software Engineer II
description:
For nearly 40 years, PDI has helped convenience retailers and petroleum wholesalers adapt to changes in the industry by leveraging the latest technologies. Simplifying the complexity in your world is our main focus. That's why we're delivering an integrated portfolio of global, cloud-based solutions and services to meet our customers needs today and well into the future. From the back office to fuel logistics, and the latest wave of consumer demands and digital commerce, PDI solutions and services are designed to give you a competitive edge. Our deep domain knowledge is backed by our industry-specific software offerings and a people-first approach. Serving the entire supply chain means that we’ve had to solve a wide range of industry challenges and deliver measurable value. To address the increasingly dynamic convenience retail and petroleum wholesale industry, PDI leads the way with converged digital, cloud-optimized, secure, and scalable solutions including ERP, Loyalty, Fuel Pricing, Point-of-Sale and Logistics to create a broader industry ecosystem. The result is unparalleled insights, simplified operations, and higher profitability for your employees and business. We’re dedicated to helping our more than 1,500 customers in over 50 countries, providing solutions and services to over 200,000 sites.

PDI C-Store Essentials is cloud back-office software for convenience store owners and operators. It covers pricebook and promotions, point-of-sale integration, fuel, lottery, daily paperwork, scan data reporting and subscription billing, for single stores, chains and franchise operators.

You will build and maintain features across the Essentials web application, its .NET services and its databases, as part of a team split between India and the United States. The team works AI-first: coding agents are part of how every engineer plans, builds, tests and reviews work, and this role is expected to use them well from day one. 

Job Responsibilities: 
- Design, build and ship features across the stack: React and TypeScript on the front end, ASP.NET Core services and APIs on the back end, SQL Server and PostgreSQL underneath

- Take part in design decisions for new and existing features, raise risks early and ask for help when blocked

- Work with the Product Owner to clarify requirements, break them into small deliverable pieces and estimate them

- Write automated tests for your own work (xUnit, Vitest, Playwright) and work with QA engineers on test plans and release stabilization. 

- Troubleshoot and fix development and production issues with urgency, using logs and monitoring to find the root cause. 

- Review teammates' pull requests and respond to review on your own. 

- Keep documentation of what you build current, including the instructions and context that coding agents rely on

- Give your manager clear status and risk updates so work stays on schedule. 

AI-driven development (AIDLC) The team follows an AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC): coding agents take part in every stage of delivery, and engineers direct, check and own the result. This is a core requirement of the role, not a preference.
 
You will be expected to:

- Use coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor every day, across requirements, design, implementation, testing, code review and debugging. 

- Turn a user story into a clear, bounded task an agent can carry out: the goal, the constraints, the files and data involved, and how success will be checked. 

- Plan before generating: have the agent propose an approach, challenge it, and agree the design before code is written. 

- Verify everything an agent produces. Read the diff, run the tests, exercise the change in the running application, and reject work you cannot explain.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer**

* The Senior Software Engineer Developer Platform & Agentic AI is a high-impact technical contributor responsible for designing and building the backend services, developer self-service APIs, middleware integrations and intelligent automation tools that accelerate software engineering across Woolworths Group.
* Unlike a conventional application developer focused on individual product features, this engineer builds reusable engineering capabilities that empower hundreds of digital engineering squads to build, test, review and release software safely and rapidly. The ideal candidate combines strong backend and distributed systems engineering with hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI agents, skills and SDLC integrations to automate engineering workflows, improve code quality and strengthen software delivery.

  

***Woolworths Group India is partnering exclusively with Zinnov Group to recruit for this position.***

  

**About this role**

The Senior Software Engineer will play a pivotal role in building and evolving Woolworths Group's internal developer platform and next-generation AI-enabled engineering ecosystem. You will design scalable backend components, developer-facing APIs, SDKs and middleware plugins that simplify complex engineering workflows and enable consistent engineering practices across a large technology organisation.

A key part of the role is developing and integrating Agentic AI capabilities into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). This includes building intelligent agents and reusable skills that support automated quality engineering, pull-request management and reviews, test generation, code quality assessment, security validation and developer productivity. Working closely with platform engineering, quality engineering, security and product development teams, you will translate engineering challenges into reusable platform capabilities that can be adopted across hundreds of squads.

  

**What youll do**

* Backend Engineering & Architecture: Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services, reusable software components, internal APIs and platform capabilities using Go, Java/Kotlin or Python.
* Developer Platform Engineering: Build developer self-service APIs, SDKs, middleware plugins and automation utilities that simplify engineering workflows and improve developer experience across the organisation.
* Agentic AI Engineering: Design, build and deploy AI agents, agent skills and intelligent workflows that integrate directly into developer tools and SDLC processes.
* AI-Powered Engineering Automation: Develop agents to automate and enhance pull-request management, code reviews, test-case generation, QA automation, defect triage, code quality checks and security validation.
* API & Integration Development: Design robust RESTful APIs and gRPC services, publish OpenAPI specifications and integrate with event-driven systems and enterprise engineering platforms.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Build resilient microservices and distributed components using asynchronous processing, event-driven architecture, caching, idempotency, retries, rate limiting and fault-tolerance patterns.
* Data & Persistence: Design and optimise relational and NoSQL data models, database schemas, indexing strategies and queries to support scalable platform services.
* Cloud-Native Engineering: Build and deploy containerised applications using Docker and Kubernetes, contributing to production-grade services and platform integrations.
* CI/CD & Engineering Enablement: Develop and maintain automated build, test and deployment pipelines, integrating platform capabilities and AI-driven quality checks into engineering workflows.
* Engineering Excellence: Establish standards for clean code, automated testing, API design, observability, performance, security and maintainability.
* Technical Collaboration: Work with engineering squads and platform stakeholders across Australia and India to identify developer pain points, influence technical decisions and drive adoption of reusable engineering solutions.

  

**What youll bring**

* **Career Trajectory:** Typically 6-10 years of strong hands-on software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering backend services, distributed systems, developer platforms or internal engineering tools.
* **Agentic AI Experience:** Ideally 3-4 years of practical experience building or integrating AI agents, agent skills and LLM-powered automation into software engineering workflows and the SDLC. Strong evidence of hands-on agent development is essential; familiarity with AI coding assistants alone will not be sufficient.
* **Backend Programming:** Strong proficiency in at least one of **Go, Java/Kotlin or Python**, with sound understanding of object-oriented and/or functional programming, concurrency, asynchronous processing, clean code and automated testing.
* **API Design & Integration:** Hands-on experience designing RESTful APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, gRPC and Protocol Buffers, alongside event-driven integrations using Kafka, RabbitMQ or Azure Event Hubs.
* **Distributed Systems & Microservices:** Strong understanding of microservices architecture, service communication, distributed caching, idempotency, resilience patterns, retries, circuit breakers and rate limiting.
* **Database Engineering:** Practical experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Cosmos DB, including schema design, indexing and query optimisation.
* **Cloud-Native Development:** Experience building and deploying containerised applications using Docker and running services on Kubernetes, with an understanding of container lifecycle and production deployment practices.
* **Developer Platform & CI/CD:** Experience building internal developer tools, reusable APIs, SDKs, platform integrations or automation utilities, along with hands-on CI/CD pipeline development, preferably using GitHub Actions.
* **AI Engineering for SDLC:** Demonstrated experience integrating LLMs, agent tools and engineering workflows to automate activities such as pull-request reviews, test generation, defect analysis, code quality assessment and security validation.
* **Engineering Quality & Security:** Strong understanding of software testing, code quality, secure coding practices, application security and production-readiness standards.

  

**Desirable / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with **Backstage.io** or other Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs).
* Experience developing Kubernetes operators, Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), CLI plugins or platform extensions.
* Experience with GraphQL, API gateways such as Apigee, and custom gateway policies or callouts.
* Familiarity with Redis, Memcached, MongoDB sharding, CockroachDB or distributed transaction patterns such as the Outbox pattern.
* Experience with AI agent orchestration frameworks, tool calling, MCP-based integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent evaluation and guardrails.
* Exposure to Terraform, GitOps and cloud infrastructure automation.
* Experience building high-throughput, enterprise-scale backend services or engineering platforms adopted by multiple development teams.
* Background in software product engineering, core infrastructure engineering or global engineering centres within organisations such as Target, Walmart, Tesco, Lowe's or engineering consultancies such as Thoughtworks, Coditas and Josh Software.

  

**What youll experience**

* Be a part of Australias largest retailer
* Constant mentoring and training provided
* Generous performance based bonus
* 20 days annual leave
* A flexible approach to work
* Premium insurance coverage for you and your dependants

We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems.
