title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

  

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

  

Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

  

**How it works**

1. **Apply.** Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
2. **Propose.** Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
3. **Build.** In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
4. **Stress-test.** Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
5. **Model testing.** Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
6. **Review.** A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
7. **Next task.** Once your task is accepted, start another.

  

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of professional software engineering
* Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
* Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
* Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
* Regular use of an AI coding tool
* Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
* You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
* At least 10 hours a week, starting now
* A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

  

**Nice to have**

* Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
* Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

  

**Terms**

* Between US$400 - US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
* Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
* The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
* Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

  

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

description:
**Job Summary**    

**Senior TypeScript Engineer**    
  **WPP Open**  Engineering Gurugram

WPP Open is WPPs AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Senior Engineer you own a component or service, from its design and API to its tests and production health, and you mentor other engineers. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.

  
   
  **Responsibilities**    

* Design, build, test and ship production code every sprint, test-first.
* Own a component or service end to end: its design, OpenAPI contract, data model, Playwright test suite, monitoring and runbook.
* Write design documents and architecture decision records for your component, and review other engineers code with rigour and care.
* Choose between AWS Lambda and Kubernetes for your workloads, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipeline that ships them.
* Lead triage when your component fails, write post-incident reviews and fix the underlying causes.
* Build production AI features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, and maintain your components Claude Code configuration and MCP server.
* Explain technical trade-offs to product and delivery colleagues, including colleagues in other regions.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and help new joiners become productive quickly

  
   
  **Minimum qualifications**    

* Bachelors degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining or launching production software, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with stakeholders in other regions.
* Language and craft. You write strict, idiomatic TypeScript, including advanced types and runtime validation at service boundaries with Zod. You understand the Node.js event loop well enough to recognise and fix blocking work, and you can profile CPU and memory when a service misbehaves. You know NestJS or Fastify in depth and structure packages so that a codebase stays easy to change.
* APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI and own the contract for your service, including versioning, backwards compatibility, idempotency keys, rate limiting and webhooks. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and you check schema compatibility automatically in your pipeline.
* Data. You design PostgreSQL schemas and change them without downtime, tune slow queries and understand transaction isolation. You model data well in both DynamoDB and MongoDB, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload with clear reasons.
* Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design producers and consumers on queues such as SQS and BullMQ, with retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent handlers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You recognise when these safeguards are needed before anyone asks.
* Cloud and platform. You design services on AWS Lambda, with sensible function boundaries, concurrency settings, dead-letter queues and Step Functions or EventBridge where needed, all defined as code with AWS CDK or SAM. You operate workloads on Kubernetes, including Helm, autoscaling, rollouts and rollbacks, and you choose between serverless and containers for each workload.
* Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and apply it to the design of whole components, not just individual functions. You write integration and contract tests with Testcontainers and own your components Playwright test suite, including test data, parallel runs and removing flaky tests.
* Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry, own the Datadog monitors, alerts and CloudWatch alarms for your component, and lead triage and post-incident reviews when it fails. You set performance budgets, profile under realistic load, and find memory leaks and blocking work in production.
* Security and identity. You implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect end to end, including the authorisation-code flow with PKCE and client credentials for service-to-service calls. You design role based access control, rotate secrets and keys, and secure your supply chain with dependency scanning and static analysis in the pipeline.
* Architecture and design. You design a service from a short brief, write design documents and architecture decision records that name the trade-offs, and design for backwards compatibility so that changes do not break the people who depend on your service.
* Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow and hold others to it in code review. You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, treat every dependency as something to pin and upgrade on a regular cadence, and write documentation for the people who will read it.
* AI-first engineering and LLMs. You build production features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, using tool calling, structured output and evaluations, and you track token usage and cost. You maintain the Claude Code configuration for your component, including CLAUDE.md, skills and subagents, and have built an MCP server that exposes your service to AI agents.
* Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely, and you explain technical trade-offs to product, design and delivery colleagues in terms they can act on. You understand problems quickly and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and time zones, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly. You are proactive: you spot problems before you are asked, propose solutions and improvements of your own, and see them through without waiting for instructions.
* Leadership and behaviours. You review others code with rigour and care, mentor less experienced engineers, and disagree openly when you need to and then commit fully to the decision. You say "I dont know" when you dont, and you dig in until you do.

  
   
  **Preferred Qualifications**    

* B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Experience with monorepo tooling such as Nx or Turborepo at scale.
* Experience with Kafka and change data capture.
* Experience with behaviour-driven development using Cucumber.
* Experience with Bigtable.
* Experience shipping an AI agent with LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
* Experience configuring an identity provider such as Okta, Keycloak or Cognito.

We are looking for a Forward Deploy Engineer with 10+ years of full stack experience across Java, React, and AI to work directly embedded within client environments. You will combine deep technical expertise in Java backend engineering, React frontend development, and AI / GenAI integration acting as the technical face of the organisation with clients. This is a rare combination of hands-on engineering excellence and strong client engagement skills you will write production code, design solutions, and build trusted technical relationships with client engineering teams simultaneously.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work embedded within client environments — delivering hands-on Java, React, and AI engineering solutions directly alongside client engineering teams.
* Design and develop scalable Java microservices and REST APIs using Spring Boot applying clean architecture and SOLID principles.
* Build high-performance React.js frontend applications using TypeScript, Redux, and modern JavaScript delivering exceptional user experiences.
* Design and integrate AI / GenAI solutions — RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, agentic workflows, and AI-powered features — into enterprise Java and React applications.
* Own end-to-end feature delivery across backend, frontend, and AI layers — from architecture design through to production deployment.
* Act as the primary technical interface with client stakeholders — engaging engineering leads, architects, and CTOs with confidence, credibility, and technical authority.
* Identify and articulate client technical challenges — rapidly prototyping and delivering solutions that demonstrate immediate business value.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical assessments within client environments — providing clear, actionable recommendations aligned to client technology strategy.
* Collaborate with internal product and engineering teams — feeding client insights, technical requirements, and AI use cases back into the product roadmap.
* Mentor client engineering teams — upskilling developers in Java, React, and AI engineering best practices through hands-on pairing and knowledge sharing.

  

**What We're Looking For**

1. 10+ years of full stack engineering experience with deep proven expertise across Java backend, React frontend, and AI / GenAI integration in production environments.
2. Deep Java proficiency including Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Cloud, Hibernate / JPA, and microservices design patterns.
3. Strong React.js expertise including TypeScript, Redux / Context API, state management, and REST API integration in large-scale enterprise applications.
4. Proven AI / GenAI engineering experience including LLM integration, RAG pipeline design, prompt engineering, and agentic workflow development using LangChain or LlamaIndex.
5. Strong cloud platform experience across AWS or Azure including Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipeline management.
6. Exceptional client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills — able to engage CTOs, engineering directors, and technical teams with authority and credibility.
7. Proven ability to rapidly understand complex client environments, identify technical challenges, and deliver pragmatic, high-quality solutions at pace.
8. Experience working in client-facing or consulting engineering roles — comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving, and high-visibility client delivery environments.
9. Strong system design and architecture skills — distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and API-first design.
10. Excellent written and verbal communication skills — producing clear technical proposals, architecture documents, and client-facing presentations.

title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Software Development Engineer - Tejas","description":"

Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and todays agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.

Our team builds Sarvams context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprises data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.

  
  **About Sarvam** 

Sarvam is Indias leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.

  
  **What this role promises you** 

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvams models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.

  
  **What youll do** 

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.

  
  **Who you are** 

We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they dont.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

 **Bonus points** 

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup

Kafka is the backbone of how data moves through Sumo Logic, and every team that builds on it needs clusters that are predictable, reliable and easy to manage. As a Software Engineer within the Kafka Infrastructure team, you will build and maintain the tools and frameworks that manage the full lifecycle of Kafka clusters at Sumo Logic. The team acts as the platform and center of excellence for Kafka, with the long-term goal of unifying Kafka operations under a single, consistent usage pattern. You will contribute to the automation that lets teams spin up, tear down, migrate and manage Kafka clusters and topics themselves, as part of Sumo Logics internal Platform-as-a-Service.

  
   
  **Responsibilities**    

* Build and maintain automation and tooling for the Kafka cluster lifecycle: provisioning, upgrades, scaling, failover and migration
* Develop and own the self-service interfaces teams use to consume Kafka (Terraform modules, CLI tools, APIs, dashboards), with predictable, versioned behavior
* Maintain and evolve the teams core components, including cluster balancing, consumer-lag monitoring, schema management, cluster-to-cluster data migration, Kafka-to-S3 backup and hardened machine images
* Improve observability and operational practices for Kafka across the organization, and drive standardization of tooling
* Provide second-level support for Kafka clusters, and participate in the on-call rotation (with an eventual move into the PaaS global on-call rotation)
* Educate and collaborate with application teams through onboarding sessions, documentation and migration guides, and consult on partitioning, consumer-group and schema best practices
* Evaluate and test new Kafka technologies and designs, and make recommendations
* Write detailed design documents and documentation on system design and implementation

  
   
  **Required Qualifications and Skills**    

* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or another scientific or technical discipline.
* Ability to influence: Understand peoples values and motivations and influence them towards making good architectural choices.
* Collaborative working style: You can work with other engineers to come up with good decisions.
* Bias towards action: You need to make things happen. It is essential you dont become an inhibitor of progress, but an enabler.
* Flexibility: You are willing to learn and change. Admit past approaches might not be the right ones now.
* **Technical skills**  :
  + 2+ years of experience in software development in Java/Scala/Golang or similar.
  + 1+ years of hands-on experience with Apache Kafka, including brokers, topics, partitions, replication and consumer groups.
  + Good understanding of Kafka internals and operations: partition reassignment and rebalancing, leader election and in-sync replicas, retention and compaction, and broker and consumer performance tuning.
  + Experience with cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP (AWS preferred).
  + Skilled in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools, specifically Terraform.
  + Proficient in scripting languages such as Python/Bash.
  + Comfortable with Linux administration and troubleshooting distributed systems in production.
  + Familiarity with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or similar, including consumer-lag monitoring.
  + Working knowledge of CI/CD and version control workflows.
  + Knowledgeable in the security aspects of Kafka (TLS, authentication and authorization).

  
   
  **Nice to have**    

* Experience with Cruise Control, Schema Registry, Kafka Connect or MirrorMaker.
* Experience building hardened machine images (for example with Packer).
* Experience with Kubernetes and GitOps.
* Experience building CLI tools or internal developer platforms.

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely.
  
  
In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data.

* Maintain Performance
    
  Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance.
* Debug and Test
    
  Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running.
* Develop for the Future
    
  Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services.

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

Required skills and experience

* Minimum 7 years of professional experience in software development.
* Proven experience as a Software Engineer working on complex enterprise-scale software projects.
* Strong hands-on development experience in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Python, AWS (Lambda, SNS, API Gateway) or Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and AWS, with excellent coding, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of CI/CD practices with hands-on experience using GitLab CI/CD or GitHub Actions, along with React.js development experience.
* Strong knowledge of software development methodologies and experience building scalable, reliable, and high-performance applications.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, XML/JSON, and RESTful web services.
* Sound understanding of software architecture, including Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes (K8s), and messaging systems.
Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), design patterns, and clean coding principles.  

Preferred skills and experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl.
Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support.

**What you'll own in your first year**
--------------------------------------

* **Own:** Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix.
* **Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones.** Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself.
* **Design.** Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
* **Quality.** Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
* **Customers.** Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
* **Code reviews.** Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.

**What you must bring**
-----------------------

These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.

* **Experience:** 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
* **You've shipped code that runs in production.** Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes.
* **You are strong at problem solving.** You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
* **You work independently toward a clear goal.** Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

**Technical background**
------------------------

You've built production software with a modern stack, such as:

* **Cloud:** hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it.
* **Languages:** strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* **Frameworks:** modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
* **Databases:** solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it.
* **Fundamentals:** data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

**What sets great candidates apart**
------------------------------------

* **Impact you can explain.** You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability.
* **One problem you went deep on.** A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why.
* **Ownership beyond the ticket.** You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked.
* **Framework mindset:** You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable.
* **Learning speed.** You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it.
* **Curiosity about the user.** You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem.

**What we look for in everyone we hire**
----------------------------------------

Whatever the role, we hire for six things.

* **Customer obsession.** You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them.
* **Impact over activity.** You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written.
* **Honesty.** You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work.
* **Independence.** You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey.
* **Passion.** Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to.
* **Depth.** At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs.

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!  
  
The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.  
  
Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

description:

**Overview**
------------

### **About us**

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**About Energy Systems**

  
We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

### **About the role**

The Senior AI Software Engineer designs, develops, and maintains production-grade AI engines, APIs, services, and reusable platform enhancements across Digital & Transformation. Sitting within the Data & AI Engineering section, the role builds the AI capabilities that power the broader platform, ensuring they are scalable, reusable, secure, and able to support multiple customer implementations and business workflows. The work helps advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification & Assurance, and Renewables Certification across Energy Systems.

An *AI engine* here is a reusable, API-exposed service that packages LLM orchestration, prompts, retrieval, and extraction logic so it can serve multiple products and customer implementations.

You will work in close partnership with Product leadership, Solution Engineering, Application Engineering, Platform Reliability, and Solution Architecture, translating product needs, implementation feedback, and complex workflow requirements into reliable, maintainable, production-ready solutions. The focus is on intelligent document processing and extraction, LLM-powered workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI that can understand, process, and generate structured information from complex documents.

Python and hands-on AI engine development are the primary technical requirements. Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and other AI orchestration frameworks is highly relevant. JavaScript and Node.js experience is a plus.

**This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Engines, LLM Orchestration, RAG & Agentic AI**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable AI engines that provide reusable intelligence and automation across multiple platform implementations.
* Build modular, LLM-powered architectures using LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable orchestration frameworks, supporting multiple models, prompts, agents, tools, and workflows.
* Integrate and manage LLM providers such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and other relevant model providers, with model selection, fallback, token management, context handling, and cost optimization.
* Design and implement agentic workflows involving multi-step reasoning, tool calling, function calling, and task orchestration.
* Design and implement RAG architectures using vector databases and embedding models for semantic search, contextual retrieval, and knowledge-based applications.
* Build AI-powered search, chatbot, document query, and intelligent reporting capabilities, with conversation memory and context management.

**Intelligent Document Processing & Extraction**

* Build end-to-end document intelligence pipelines covering ingestion, preprocessing, classification, extraction, validation, and structured output generation.
* Develop advanced, document-aware extraction workflows using LLMs and prompt engineering for complex, unstructured documents in formats such as PDF, DOCX, and spreadsheets (scanned documents are a plus).
* Implement context-aware extraction across pages, sections, tables, and related documents, supporting single-document, multi-document, and cross-document scenarios.
* Handle complex structures, missing information, ambiguous content, and varying layouts, with confidence scoring, validation rules, and exception handling.
* Develop reusable extraction templates, prompt configurations, and document-specific processing strategies.
* Optimize extraction accuracy, processing time, token consumption, and overall AI execution cost.

**Backend Engineering, APIs & Platform Integration**

* Develop scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices that expose AI engine capabilities to enterprise applications, primarily using Python, FastAPI, Pydantic.
* Design asynchronous processing, event-driven workflows, streaming responses, and background processing for long-running AI operations.
* Establish reusable API contracts, shared services, and integration patterns that ensure interoperability across platform components.
* Integrate AI engines with document management systems, databases, cloud storage, and enterprise applications.
* Implement secure document access, tenant isolation, authorization, and data-handling mechanisms across AI workflows.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases, object storage, and vector databases, keeping services modular, scalable, and independently deployable.

**AI Quality, Evaluation & Optimization**

* Develop evaluation strategies and testing frameworks to measure AI output quality, extraction accuracy, and model performance.
* Validate structured AI outputs against predefined schemas, business rules, and expected results.
* Implement prompt evaluation, model comparison, regression testing, and continuous improvement workflows.
* Analyze failed extractions, retrieval inaccuracies, hallucinations, and inconsistent responses, and optimize prompts, retrieval strategies, model configurations, and orchestration accordingly.
* Build reusable evaluation datasets, test scenarios, and quality benchmarks.
* Ensure AI solutions are explainable, traceable, measurable, and suitable for production.

**Engineering Practices, Reliability & Security**

* Use AI-assisted development practices to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, refactoring, and analysis, while maintaining strong code quality, security, and review standards.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, and production monitoring.
* Build reliable AI services with appropriate logging, observability, error handling, retry and timeout mechanisms, rate limiting, and fault tolerance.
* Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise expectations, with attention to data handling, access control, auditability, and responsible AI.
* Take ownership of AI services from architecture and development through deployment and production support.

**Collaboration, Technical Ownership & Leadership**

* Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Application Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and other stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into practical AI architectures and implementation approaches.
* Review feature requests from Solution Engineering and help turn requirements into reusable product or platform enhancements.
* Collaborate with Solution Engineering on complex document types, failed extractions, prompt optimization, and reusable implementation patterns.
* Own the technical decisions for the components you build, and drive complex challenges independently from design through production support.
* Lead design and code reviews to ensure consistency, maintainability, and engineering quality.
* Mentor and guide other engineers on AI engine architecture, prompt engineering, document extraction, and integration patterns.

Support knowledge transfer to Solution Engineering and Application Engineering, and contribute to technical standards, reusable frameworks, architecture documentation, and engineering best practices.

### **What we offer**

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on experience developing AI-enabled applications, backend services, AI engines, or intelligent platforms.
* Strong Python programming skills, with hands-on experience designing and developing production-grade AI engines and LLM-powered applications.
* Hands-on experience building AI engines with LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable AI orchestration frameworks.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, model integration, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, and structured outputs.
* Proven experience developing intelligent document processing and extraction solutions using LLMs, including ingestion, preprocessing, classification, extraction, validation, and structured data generation.
* Practical experience with RAG architectures, vector search, and semantic retrieval, and with building AI agents, multi-step workflows, and tool or function calling.
* Experience building backend services, REST APIs, and asynchronous processing using Python and FastAPI or equivalent technologies, with relational or NoSQL databases and cloud storage.
* Understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, extraction accuracy measurement, and prompt optimization.
* Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, source control, and code review, and a strong grasp of software architecture, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Ability to independently troubleshoot complex AI engineering challenges and deliver production-ready solutions.

**What Is Preferred**

* Experience building AI engines or reusable AI platforms from the ground up.
* Experience with document intelligence platforms, intelligent document processing (IDP), OCR, document parsing tools, and complex data extraction.
* Familiarity with multimodal AI, vision-language models, and processing scanned or image-based documents.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or other LLM providers.
* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, MongoDB, or similar technologies.
* Experience with cloud-native AI deployments on Azure, and with Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architectures, and distributed processing.
* Experience with modern UI frameworks such as React or comparable frontend frameworks.
* Familiarity with JavaScript and Node.js for backend development, API integrations, and platform interoperability.
* Background in energy, infrastructure, renewables, due diligence, verification, assurance, certification, or other technically complex industries.
* Experience developing reusable prompt libraries, AI evaluation frameworks, and enterprise AI engineering standards.

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*

Please note that some benefits may vary depending on location, business area, and employment terms. Please confirm with your recruiter.

### **Profit Share**

You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. This will be part of our Total Compensation approach each year and depends on our year-end results.

### **Professional Development**

We believe in the 70/20/10 learning model, where 70% of your learning comes from performing your everyday tasks and working on different projects, new areas and initiatives to gain new skills. 20% from working with others and mentoring and the rest from formal education.

### **Hybrid Work Model**

We work in a hybrid model (three days from the office) and have flexible starting hours. This means you can fit your work and life together in a way that works for you.

### **Global Opportunities**

We support you in exploring different career opportunities or shifting between teams, business areas, or geographies, so that you can shape your career according to what you find motivating.

### **Modern Office in Pune**

Our office in Pune has a modern look and feel and you’ll find zones for both focused work and team integration. Sit/stand desks, high-quality adjustable chairs and balance balls are just a few examples of what ergonomic office means at DNV.

### **Integration Events**

Depending on where you are located, you’ll have the opportunity to participate in offsite meetings as well as different initiatives and fun events at the office. We believe that a well-integrated team is a well-functioning team.

### **Global opportunities**

Collaborate with colleagues around the world, build your network and gain exposure to different markets, industries and perspectives.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
-----------------------------------

At DNV, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not only an ethical choice, but also a business decision.

Diversity, fairness, and a sense of belonging are a source of strength for our people, our business, and our customers, and help us to deliver on our purpose, vision, and values.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Who We Are.**

Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end-to-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional-level clients.

**Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!**

Axi's trading platforms serve a global client base around the clock, and the pace at which we need to ship — new features, new products, new capabilities — has outgrown our current fullstack capacity. This role exists to close that gap directly: you will own end-to-end delivery of complex, high-performance features across .NET backend services and React frontends, making architectural calls independently rather than waiting for a queue to clear. You will also set the engineering bar for the India-based team, raising standards that compound across every sprint and every release.

**Your EDGE Assignment/You Will**

* Own end-to-end design and delivery of core platform features — from API contracts and service layer decisions in C#/.NET Core through to React component architecture and state management on the frontend.
* Build ancillary products and internal tools that expand what traders and operations teams can do on the platform, taking each initiative from requirements to production.
* Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks across the stack — query plans, service latency, rendering inefficiency — to keep the platform highly available and fast under real trading-volume load.
* Design and implement event-driven workflows using Azure Service Bus and Event Grid, building the asynchronous, distributed interactions that keep platform services decoupled and resilient.
* Design and optimise SQL Server schemas, indexes, and queries for high-throughput transactional workloads where data integrity and latency both matter.
* Drive engineering quality within the team — establish and iterate on coding standards, review practices, and architectural patterns so that the team's output improves as a whole, not just your own PRs.
* Own production support responsibilities within the on-call rotation: diagnose, resolve, and lead post-incident learning for issues on a 24/7 platform where downtime has direct commercial consequence.
* Undertake any additional duties, projects and responsibilities as reasonably assigned to support evolving business and operational requirements.

**Are you the one?**

* 5–9 years of experience building and shipping production software, with substantial fullstack work spanning both backend services and frontend applications throughout your career.
* Deep, hands-on experience with C# and .NET Core — not just maintenance work, but greenfield service design, API architecture, and production ownership at meaningful scale.
* Proven experience with React and Redux or the Context API, including component architecture decisions, state management patterns, and TypeScript integration across non-trivial frontend codebases.
* Solid command of SQL — schema design, query optimisation, and index tuning for transactional workloads, not just basic CRUD.
* Practical experience integrating messaging systems such as Azure Service Bus or Event Grid to build event-driven, asynchronous workflows across distributed services.
* Background in fintech, trading platforms, or other mission-critical, high-availability domains is a strong advantage — you understand what it means when the system cannot go down.
* Experience with React Native is preferred; familiarity with Azure API Management (APIM) is a good addition to bring.
* Proven ability to debug complex, distributed systems under pressure, including production incidents on live platforms.
* Comfortable making architectural decisions independently and defending those decisions in a distributed, Agile team — you do not need a committee to move forward on hard problems.
* A track record of raising engineering standards around you — through code reviews, design feedback, or process improvements — not just delivering your own work well.

**Axi's bag of delights**

* Competitive total rewards package.
* Extensive learning opportunities, including professional certifications and continuous development.
* 21 annual leave days per year.
* Public holidays as declared by the local government.
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage.

**Axi's interview journey**

* Talent Acquisition Interview (45 minutes)
* Technical Interview – Coding (60–90 minutes)
* Technical Interview – System Design (60–75 minutes)
* Technical Interview – Architecture (60 minutes)

Please note that our organisation works with recruitment agencies on a pre-approved basis only. A recruitment agency that wishes to submit candidate profiles or résumés for consideration must obtain prior written consent from our Talent Acquisition team. We do not accept unsolicited résumés from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited résumés. Should we receive an unsolicited résumé from a recruitment agency that does not have prior written consent, we will not be responsible for the payment of any fees related to the recruitment of the candidate represented in the unsolicited résumé.

At Axi, we prioritize creating a workplace that upholds fairness and respect for all. We encourage every individual within our community to contribute towards a culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is treated with the dignity they deserve. We make all employment-related decisions — whether in hiring, compensation, training, performance reviews, or termination — based on merit and without bias, ensuring equal opportunities for everyone. We consciously work to identify and overcome any unconscious biases, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee and candidate feels genuinely welcomed and valued.

**About the Role**

We are building a mobile-first attendance platform that uses facial recognition for single-person check-in and group classroom attendance. The selected candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining the backend platform, including APIs, database architecture, face-embedding storage, similarity search, asynchronous group-photo processing, authentication, role-based access control, real-time updates, and secure handling of biometric data.

The developer will build the backend services consumed by the mobile application and implement the processing pipeline to identify students from group classroom photographs by matching them against the respective class rosters.

The developer will work closely with the Computer Vision/AI Engineer on the face-recognition pipeline and with the mobile developer on API and WebSocket integrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop asynchronous APIs using Python and FastAPI for students, teachers, classes, enrollments, attendance sessions, and attendance records.
* Implement JWT authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), rate limiting, and secure file uploads.
* Integrate the face-recognition pipeline: face detection → embedding extraction (ArcFace/FaceNet) → 1 cosine similarity matching with class/section-based roster filtering.
* Implement asynchronous group-photo processing using Celery and Redis, with job status tracking.
* Return annotated results, including bounding boxes, matched student IDs, confidence scores, and unmatched face indicators.
* Design PostgreSQL and pgvector schemas with IVFFlat/HNSW indexes for efficient embedding searches.
* Integrate S3-compatible storage for temporary image storage with lifecycle policies.
* Implement WebSocket-based updates to track group-attendance processing progress.
* Ensure encryption at rest, TLS, and data retention/deletion workflows in compliance with applicable regulations, including India's DPDP Act.
* Set up Docker, CI/CD pipelines, logging, monitoring, and automated testing.

**General Requirements**

* 5+ years of backend development experience using Python with FastAPI or Flask (FastAPI preferred).
* Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, migrations, and query optimization.
* Experience with pgvector or other vector databases.
* Experience with asynchronous job processing using Celery/RQ and Redis.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, JWT authentication, RBAC, and secure file uploads.
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and cloud deployment (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Experience with S3-compatible object storage.
* Knowledge of secure handling and storage of sensitive/biometric data.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
For nearly 40 years, PDI has helped convenience retailers and petroleum wholesalers adapt to changes in the industry by leveraging the latest technologies. Simplifying the complexity in your world is our main focus. That's why we're delivering an integrated portfolio of global, cloud-based solutions and services to meet our customers needs today and well into the future. From the back office to fuel logistics, and the latest wave of consumer demands and digital commerce, PDI solutions and services are designed to give you a competitive edge. Our deep domain knowledge is backed by our industry-specific software offerings and a people-first approach. Serving the entire supply chain means that we’ve had to solve a wide range of industry challenges and deliver measurable value. To address the increasingly dynamic convenience retail and petroleum wholesale industry, PDI leads the way with converged digital, cloud-optimized, secure, and scalable solutions including ERP, Loyalty, Fuel Pricing, Point-of-Sale and Logistics to create a broader industry ecosystem. The result is unparalleled insights, simplified operations, and higher profitability for your employees and business. We’re dedicated to helping our more than 1,500 customers in over 50 countries, providing solutions and services to over 200,000 sites.

PDI C-Store Essentials is cloud back-office software for convenience store owners and operators. It covers pricebook and promotions, point-of-sale integration, fuel, lottery, daily paperwork, scan data reporting and subscription billing, for single stores, chains and franchise operators.

You will build and maintain features across the Essentials web application, its .NET services and its databases, as part of a team split between India and the United States. The team works AI-first: coding agents are part of how every engineer plans, builds, tests and reviews work, and this role is expected to use them well from day one.

### **Job Responsibilities:**

* Design, build and ship features across the stack: React and TypeScript on the front end, ASP.NET Core services and APIs on the back end, SQL Server and PostgreSQL underneath.
* Take part in design decisions for new and existing features, raise risks early and ask for help when blocked.
* Work with the Product Owner to clarify requirements, break them into small deliverable pieces and estimate them.
* Write automated tests for your own work (xUnit, Vitest, Playwright) and work with QA engineers on test plans and release stabilization.
* Troubleshoot and fix development and production issues with urgency, using logs and monitoring to find the root cause.
* Review teammates' pull requests and respond to review on your own.
* Keep documentation of what you build current, including the instructions and context that coding agents rely on.
* Give your manager clear status and risk updates so work stays on schedule.

### **AI-driven development (AIDLC)**

The team follows an AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC): coding agents take part in every stage of delivery, and engineers direct, check and own the result. This is a core requirement of the role, not a preference.

You will be expected to:

* Use coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor every day, across requirements, design, implementation, testing, code review and debugging.
* Turn a user story into a clear, bounded task an agent can carry out: the goal, the constraints, the files and data involved, and how success will be checked.
* Plan before generating: have the agent propose an approach, challenge it, and agree the design before code is written.
* Verify everything an agent produces. Read the diff, run the tests, exercise the change in the running application, and reject work you cannot explain.
* Own what you merge. Code written by an agent is held to the same standard as code written by hand, and you answer for it in review and in production.
* Keep credentials, customer data and other sensitive information out of prompts and agent context, and follow PDI's AI usage policies.
* Improve the team's shared setup: project instructions, reusable prompts and skills, test fixtures and other context that make agents more reliable for everyone.
* Know when not to use an agent and recognize when one is going in circles or producing plausible but wrong output.

### **Required Skills & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field plus 4 to 6 years of experience building or maintaining software in a product development environment, or equivalent experience.
* Working proficiency in C# and .NET (ASP.NET Core), including building and consuming REST APIs.
* Working proficiency in a modern JavaScript framework with TypeScript; React is preferred.
* Solid SQL skills on a relational database (SQL Server or PostgreSQL): queries, stored procedures and basic performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience using coding agents or AI coding assistants in real project work, and the ability to show how you directed and verified their output.
* Computer science fundamentals: object-oriented programming, design patterns, data structures and algorithms.
* Practical experience with Git, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines and Agile delivery.
* Habit of writing automated tests for your own code.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical concepts in non-technical terms. Clear writing matters more here than usual, because it is also how you direct agents.
* Self-starter who can work independently as part of a distributed team, manage competing priorities and learn an unfamiliar codebase quickly.

### **Other Skills and Experience:**

* AWS experience: Lambda, SQS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch.
* Experience building agent workflows: custom instructions, skills, MCP servers or agent-run test and review loops.
* React Native or Expo mobile development.
* Payments or subscription billing integrations, such as Stripe.
* Retail, convenience store, point-of-sale or fuel domain experience.
* Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Docker and infrastructure as code (OpenTofu or Terraform).
* Monitoring and tracing with Datadog or a similar tool.
* Experience maintaining or migrating a legacy .NET Framework application.

### **Behavioral Competencies:**

* Cultivates Innovation
* Decision Quality
* Manages Complexity
* Drives Results
* Business Insight

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

To address the increasingly dynamic convenience retail and petroleum wholesale industry, PDI leads the way with converged digital, cloud-optimized, secure, and scalable solutions including ERP, Loyalty, Fuel Pricing, Point-of-Sale and Logistics to create a broader industry ecosystem. The result is unparalleled insights, simplified operations, and higher profitability for your employees and business. We’re dedicated to helping our more than 1,500 customers in over 50 countries, providing solutions and services to over 200,000 sites.

PDI C-Store Essentials is cloud back-office software for convenience store owners and operators. It covers pricebook and promotions, point-of-sale integration, fuel, lottery, daily paperwork, scan data reporting and subscription billing, for single stores, chains and franchise operators.

You will build and maintain features across the Essentials web application, its .NET services and its databases, as part of a team split between India and the United States. The team works AI-first: coding agents are part of how every engineer plans, builds, tests and reviews work, and this role is expected to use them well from day one.

### **Job Responsibilities:**

* Design, build and ship features across the stack: React and TypeScript on the front end, ASP.NET Core services and APIs on the back end, SQL Server and PostgreSQL underneath.
* Take part in design decisions for new and existing features, raise risks early and ask for help when blocked.
* Work with the Product Owner to clarify requirements, break them into small deliverable pieces and estimate them.
* Write automated tests for your own work (xUnit, Vitest, Playwright) and work with QA engineers on test plans and release stabilization.
* Troubleshoot and fix development and production issues with urgency, using logs and monitoring to find the root cause.
* Review teammates' pull requests and respond to review on your own.
* Keep documentation of what you build current, including the instructions and context that coding agents rely on.
* Give your manager clear status and risk updates so work stays on schedule.

### **AI-driven development (AIDLC)**

The team follows an AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC): coding agents take part in every stage of delivery, and engineers direct, check and own the result. This is a core requirement of the role, not a preference.

You will be expected to:

* Use coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor every day, across requirements, design, implementation, testing, code review and debugging.
* Turn a user story into a clear, bounded task an agent can carry out: the goal, the constraints, the files and data involved, and how success will be checked.
* Plan before generating: have the agent propose an approach, challenge it, and agree the design before code is written.
* Verify everything an agent produces. Read the diff, run the tests, exercise the change in the running application, and reject work you cannot explain.
* Own what you merge. Code written by an agent is held to the same standard as code written by hand, and you answer for it in review and in production.
* Keep credentials, customer data and other sensitive information out of prompts and agent context, and follow PDI's AI usage policies.
* Improve the team's shared setup: project instructions, reusable prompts and skills, test fixtures and other context that make agents more reliable for everyone.
* Know when not to use an agent and recognize when one is going in circles or producing plausible but wrong output.

### **Required Skills & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field plus 4 to 6 years of experience building or maintaining software in a product development environment, or equivalent experience.
* Working proficiency in C# and .NET (ASP.NET Core), including building and consuming REST APIs.
* Working proficiency in a modern JavaScript framework with TypeScript; React is preferred.
* Solid SQL skills on a relational database (SQL Server or PostgreSQL): queries, stored procedures and basic performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience using coding agents or AI coding assistants in real project work, and the ability to show how you directed and verified their output.

* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical concepts in non-technical terms. Clear writing matters more here than usual, because it is also how you direct agents.
* Self-starter who can work independently as part of a distributed team, manage competing priorities and learn an unfamiliar codebase quickly.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Advanced Threat Protection
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Role 

We seek a knowledgeable and research-focused Security Engineer to join a new Advanced Threat Protection team within Auth0 Customer Identity. This role does two things at once: it researches how attackers will use AI against identity systems, and it researches and builds how we use AI to defend our products, our infrastructure, and — most importantly — our customers' tenants.

This role is a key member of the Security team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to get ahead of emerging AI threats, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused team that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you won't just assess our current AI security offering — you'll research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, turn that research into concrete protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

In this role you will work as part of a globally distributed team of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the members of the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment.

This is a level-agnostic description; scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level (Senior through Staff).

Responsibilities:

- Research and lead how we can use AI to protect customer tenants — both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response) 

- Research and build protections against novel AI attacks that Auth0 and Auth0's customers can be subjected to — adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP, and emerging equivalents), model and data poisoning — as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants

- Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through AI-assisted defenses 

- Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12–24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from — then architect, recommend, and build the tooling to get there 

- Review and harden Auth0's AI security offering, identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited 

- Partner across a globally distributed product-aligned team of security engineers to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants 

- Establish a deep understanding of Okta Customer Identity products and infrastructure 

- Build, deploy & maintain scalable security solutions and automation that operationalize AI threat defenses at scale 

- Help meet our operational security commitments by thinking like an attacker, assessing the risk, and advising on mitigation strategies 

- Collaborate with the Okta Security team on security operations and, where relevant, support investigations and root cause analysis

What this position is not: 

- Dedicated application security, code review, or compliance-focused work 

- Reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function — this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them

Requirements:

- You have hands-on experience with AI/ML security — attacking, defending, or both (e.g., adversarial ML, LLM/prompt-injection attacks, agentic-system or model abuse), and an interest in using AI to build defenses, not just to study attacks 

- You have 4+ years of experience in security engineering, with a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure and/or product security 

- You have hands-on development experience — Go preferred — sufficient to prototype tooling, build AI-powered defenses, and operationalize your research 

- You have working knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more of the following: 

- AWS and/or Azure security 

- Kubernetes 

- You have strong knowledge of OWASP (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices 

- You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices 

- You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams 

- You have experience working with a globally distributed and remote team

Bonus points if:

- You have published threat research, CVEs, or conference talks in AI/ML security or identity security 

- You have built AI/ML-powered security tooling or defensive automation in a production environment 

- You have working knowledge and experience with one or more of the following: 

- Adversarial ML, model red-teaming, or AI safety research 

- The AI agent / MCP ecosystem and its security implications 

- Identity and access management 

- Full-stack engineering 

- Site reliability engineering 

- Vulnerability and threat management 

- Governance, risk and compliance
